meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow: the user themselves saying ulw-plan, ulw plan, /skill:ulw-plan, or asking in their own words for a work plan before coding. NEVER self-activates: a bare ulw/ultrawork run, an agent-side routing decision, or reading this file is not a request, and the plan-gated reviewers (metis/momus) stay locked without a user request plus a written .omo/plans plan file. Explore-first planning consultant (Prometheus) that grounds in the codebase, asks only the forks exploration cannot resolve - or researches them to best practice when the intent is fuzzy - waits for explicit approval, then writes ONE decision-complete work plan a worker executes with zero further interview. Triggers: ulw-plan, ulw plan, plan this, make a plan, plan before coding, interview me, break this down, start planning, plan mode.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 动工前把需求与取舍谈清楚,产出一份可直接执行的工作计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果写代码前想先把范围、取舍和步骤谈清楚再动手
copy.tagline_en: Talk requirements and tradeoffs through, then produce one executable work plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want scope and tradeoffs settled before writing code

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会转为规划顾问 Prometheus:只做只读探索(搜索、读代码、只读分析),只把计划文件写到 .omo/ 下,不碰产品代码、不做实现。确认后产出唯一一份决策完整的工作计划,交给执行方照做。
howto.when: 只有你本人明确要求时才会启动:说「ulw-plan」「ulw plan」「/skill:ulw-plan」,或用自己的话要求在写代码前先出计划。它不会自己激活,直接跑 ulw 也不算。

say.text: ulw-plan:给 /login 加每 IP 每分钟 5 次的限流
say.note: 先只读探索,然后等你明确同意

say.text: 先规划一下,别动手写代码
say.note: 进入粘性规划模式,不会开始实现

say.text: 意图还不清楚,帮我研究后定默认方案
say.note: 走 UNCLEAR 路线,采用默认值不再追问

howto.what_en: Claude switches to planning consultant Prometheus: read-only exploration only, writing plan artifacts under .omo/ — no product-code edits, no implementation. It produces ONE decision-complete work plan a worker then executes.
howto.when_en: Starts only on your own explicit request: saying ulw-plan, ulw plan or /skill:ulw-plan, or asking in your own words for a plan before coding. It never self-activates; a bare ulw run is not a request.

say_en.text: ulw-plan: add a 5-per-minute-per-IP rate limit to /login
say_en.note: Read-only exploration first, then it waits for your okay

say_en.text: Plan this before coding — don't write any code yet
say_en.note: Stays in sticky plan mode, no implementation

say_en.text: The goal is still fuzzy — research it and pick defaults
say_en.note: Takes the UNCLEAR path and adopts defaults
